ios.desc:
Take a break or sleep in an extra hour while children safely watch YouTube videos on their own! As seen in the New York Times, Cakey is a COMPLETELY FREE app (no ads or upsells) built by a fellow parent. 

[+] Assemble safe collections of videos for your children to watch
[+] Download collections already made by other parents
[+] Set daily viewing limits enforced but the app
[+] If you use videos to help get your child to eat, Cakey can pause every minute to remind your child to take a bite!
[+] Coming soon: ability to have reports emailed telling you what your child watched and for how long.

http://techcrunch.com/2014/11/21/hot-or-not-founder-returns-with-cakey-a-youtube-app-for-kids/
